info.title: PaymentService API
info.description: Payment Service API for payment processing, verification, and refunds in the ECommerce system.

post.summary: Initiates a compensating refund for an order (e.g., triggered when an order is cancelled or expires). Internal endpoint.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order identifier whose payment should be refunded.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Service-Key
parameters.description: Secret key required for authenticating internal inter-service requests.

400.description: Order cannot be refunded or operation error.

get.summary: Retrieves internal payment details by order identifier for inter-service validation. Internal endpoint.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Service-Key
parameters.description: Secret key required for authenticating internal inter-service requests.

404.description: Payment record not found for the given order ID.

post.summary: Creates a payment transaction for an order with idempotency guarantee.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique idempotency key header to prevent duplicate charges.

requestBody.description: Payment parameters including order identifier, amount, and payment method.

400.description: Missing Idempotency-Key header or invalid request data.

409.description: Conflicting concurrent payment request detected for key.

post.summary: Processes payment charge through the payment gateway for a created payment.

400.description: Payment failed or cannot be processed.

get.summary: Retrieves the payment record associated with a specific order.

204.description: No payment record found for this order.

post.summary: Completes a refund transaction for a payment. Requires Admin role.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique idempotency key header to prevent duplicate refund processing.

400.description: Missing Idempotency-Key header or invalid refund state.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

method.description: Payment method code (0: CreditCard, 1: DebitCard, 2: PayPal).

CreatePaymentDto.description: Request payload for creating a new payment against an existing order.

status.description: Payment transaction status (0: Pending, 1: Success, 2: Failed, 3: RefundInProcess, 4: Refunded).

method.description: Payment method (0: CreditCard, 1: DebitCard, 2: PayPal, etc.).

processedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment was processed in UTC.

PaymentDto.description: Details of a payment transaction or refund.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Enter your JWT token directly.
